evidence.S1: Overview light/dark use the same card grid and tab bar; localized screens preserve alignment.
evidence.S2: Status reads 'Listening - 2 found' while speaking; toast offers Edit and Undo.
evidence.S3: Tapping a chart bar opens that day's expenses; budget card shows projection and per-day allowance.
evidence.S4: Story card shows total, comparison, budget pace, stats and categories with clear hierarchy.
evidence.S5: CSV export, JSON backup/restore, last-backup date, storage-full warning.

fixes: Add visible empty, offline, parse-error, and storage-full states with recovery actions such as retry, restore backup, and manual entry.
Improve share card legibility: make the chart and budget-pace line clearer, add optional category detail, and verify Square, transparent, and photo modes are equally polished.
Tighten visual polish: increase chart label contrast/size, reduce dense settings instructions, and check localized strings for crowding in controls and cards.

evidence.S1: Clean hierarchy with prominent totals, consistent light/dark, proper localization (EN/ID/ZH); minor rough edges in activity list density and share sheet control clutter
evidence.S2: 'Tap the mic and say lunch 120 and taxi 250 yesterday: both expenses are parsed live and saved when you stop talking; a toast offers Edit and Undo' plus live row editing and 'No amount found' immediate feedback
evidence.S3: Totals with vs-last-month delta, budget card with per-day allowance and month-end projection, peak/average labelled chart, category percentages, drill-down on bar tap, budget pace line on share card
evidence.S4: Story card (1080x1920) is poster-grade with bold NT$3,950, budget pace line, stats grid, category bars; day/week/month, Story/Square, 8 backgrounds, transparent PNG sticker, Hide amounts, full-size preview
evidence.S5: 'Works offline (service worker), CSV export, JSON backup/restore, last-backup date, storage-full warning, persistent storage request'; 'No amount found' error state; 'Accessibility audit over 77 screens: 0 failures'

fixes: Reduce density in Activity list rows - category labels and amounts feel cramped at 390px; increase row padding or font size for better scannability
Simplify the Share sheet control layout - the stacked Background/Sticker/Hide amounts/Save image controls compete for attention; group into clearer sections or use a stepper pattern
Add visible empty/zero states for the Spending by day chart and Categories list so first-time users see guidance instead of blank or near-empty visuals

evidence.S1: Clean, consistent type/spacing across light, dark, ZH and ID screens; nits: clipped 'BUDGET' header behind the record-sheet scrim and a very small share-preview card with ambiguous 'Background Light' label.
evidence.S2: 'both expenses are parsed live and saved when you stop talking; a toast offers Edit and Undo', rows 'can be tapped to change category or amount, or removed, before Save' — but correction/undo live only in a transient toast.
evidence.S3: '$669 per day available for the remaining 24 days… $9,159 over budget' (pace), '+100% vs same point last month' (comparison), 'Tap a bar to see that day' (drill-down), categories with '37% · 6 expenses' — all 10-anchor elements present, but only one comparison basis and no multi-month trend.
evidence.S4: Story card is poster-grade: clear hierarchy (NT$3,950 hero), labeled 'Budget pace' line, 2×2 stat grid, category bars, 'Tracked by voice with Tally' footer; only the light Story variant is shown at full size, chart area is sparse.
evidence.S5: 'Works offline (service worker), CSV export, JSON backup/restore, last-backup date, storage-full warning, persistent storage request' plus immediate 'No amount found'; empty/first-run and mic-permission-denied states are not evidenced.

fixes: Show and harden empty/first-run and failure states: brand-new user with no expenses, empty Activity, 'Use suggested' with no tracked past months, and mic permission denied/unavailable fallback.
Make post-save correction persistent: add a durable 'just logged' review affordance (e.g., saved-rows chip on Overview) so Edit/Undo don't vanish when the toast expires.
Deepen summaries: add a multi-month trend line and category-level comparison/drill-down (tap a category row for its history), not just day bars and vs-last-month.
